subject: general
question: Who among the following is/was a famous proponent of Bharatanatyam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukmini Devi Arundale**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer of the Bharatanatyam style of dance.
 
• She was instrumental in reviving and popularizing Bharatanatyam, which had fallen into disrepute before her efforts.
 
• In 1936, she founded the **Kalakshetra Foundation** in Chennai, an academy dedicated to the preservation and teaching of traditional Indian arts, particularly Bharat
